findings.title: Problem overstates current execute UI gap
findings.description: Execute already has spinner, per-package rows, n/total text, completion summary (ui/execute.rs). Only ratatui Gauge is clearly missing. 'no at-a-glance per-package status' is false.
findings.resolution: Rewrote problem; Gauge is remaining gap

findings.title: StowStatus icon reuse is a design conflict
findings.description: Status icons are stow-check semantics (stowed/partial/conflict/missing). Execute rows are success/fail of a run. Blind reuse is wrong. Need design_decision: map exec outcomes to a small icon set, or keep exec-local icons and drop 'reuse Status icon set' from in_scope.
findings.resolution: design_decision keeps exec icons; StowStatus out of scope

findings.title: S2 and S3 are already implemented
findings.description: S2 rows and S3 summary exist. Leave as verify/polish steps with done evidence, or remove and keep Gauge-only scope so effort matches remaining work.

findings.title: ACs lack automated verification
findings.description: Seed ExecuteComponent in render/e2e tests and assert gauge/summary text. manual alone is weak for approved ready milestone.
